The Holderness coastline, covering 61km between the Spurn nature reserve in the south and Flamborough in the north, experiences one of the fastest rates of erosion in Europe. The Holderness cliffs are eroding at average rate of around 1.5 metres per year, although individual cliff losses can exceed 20 metres per year.
